archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for EdTech SaaS
design_philosophy: A premium, trustworthy, and modern education technology platform designed for credibility and high conversion. Inspired by Coursera, LinkedIn Learning, and Stripe. The UI emphasizes large whitespace, clean bento-style cards, soft shadows, and a highly professional palette.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#0F172A]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#0F172A]

layout_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl (16px) for cards, rounded-xl (12px) for inner elements/buttons

motion_accessibility.animations: Subtle only. Fade-in for sections (framer-motion initial opacity 0, y 20). Hover states on buttons (scale 1.02) and cards (translate-y-1, shadow increase). No flashy/excessive motion.
motion_accessibility.accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes. Contrast must meet WCAG AA standards. Focus states should be clearly visible with ring-2.

components_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#2563EB] text-white hover:bg-blue-700 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all. Secondary buttons: bg-white text-[#0F172A] border border-[#E2E8F0] hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all.
components_instructions.cards: Clean white backgrounds (#FFFFFF), soft borders (border-[#E2E8F0]), rounded-2xl, soft shadows. Use generous internal padding (p-8).
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react. Standard sizing (w-6 h-6 for cards, w-5 h-5 for lists). Color them with Secondary or Accent colors.
components_instructions.charts: Use Recharts (recharts) to build REALISTIC charts (donuts/bars/lines) for the dashboard mockups, NOT generic images. Data should look professional (e.g., AI Risk Score, Career Fit Score, Salary Forecast).

sections.name: Hero (Split Layout)
sections.left: Headline: 'Most Students Will Spend 4 Years Preparing For Careers That AI May Change.' Subheadline: 'analyze education, skills, strengths...' Primary CTA: 'Generate My Free Career Blueprint'. Secondary CTA: 'View Sample Report'.
sections.right: Professional DASHBOARD MOCKUP with REALISTIC CHARTS (Recharts) showing AI Risk Score, Career Fit Score, Salary Forecast, Skill Gap Analysis, Future Opportunities. Use a window/browser frame wrapper.

sections.name: Trust Band
sections.layout: flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-8 py-8 border-y border-[#E2E8F0] bg-white
sections.content: Checkmarks: ✓ AI-Powered Analysis ✓ Future Career Insights ✓ Personalized Roadmap ✓ Secure Payments. Payment logos: Use lucide-react icons or text to represent UPI, PhonePe, GPay, Paytm, Visa, Mastercard, and 'Secured by Razorpay'.

sections.name: Social Proof
sections.content: Professional testimonial cards. Authentic Indian student profiles (Name, Course, City, Feedback, 5-star Rating). Use Avatar initials or realistic professional photos from the provided URLs. No stock-photo look.

sections.name: Report Preview
sections.content: Actual career-blueprint report preview. Premium dashboard visuals. Top part clear, bottom part blurred out (backdrop-blur) with a central CTA 'Unlock Full Personalized Report'.

sections.name: Features
sections.content: Modern icon cards: AI Automation Risk Score, Salary Growth Forecast, Career Match Analysis, Skill Gap Assessment, Learning Roadmap, Industry Outlook. Include concise explanations.

sections.name: College Student Segments
sections.content: Cards for B.Tech, BCA, B.Com, MBA, MCA, Fresh Graduates with personalized benefits for each.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.content: Premium layout card. Regular ₹499 crossed out, Launch ₹199. Large CTA 'Get My Career Blueprint'. Highlight list: Career Roadmap, Salary Forecast, AI Risk Analysis, Future Skills Report.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.content: Modern accordion (accuracy, data privacy, report delivery, career guidance, payment security).

sections.name: Floating Action Button
sections.content: Fixed bottom-right WhatsApp button for support.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the exact color codes provided. Do not use generic tailwind slate/gray colors if it conflicts with the specified primary/secondary colors.
Do NOT use neon, dark themes, or cyberpunk aesthetics.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='cta-hero-button').
For the hero and report preview sections, you MUST build REALISTIC UI dashboard mockups using Recharts library or CSS-based charts instead of static images. Do not use AI generated generic images.
For the payment logos, if exact SVGs are unavailable, construct clean CSS badges using text and Lucide icons.
For testimonials, use the provided Unsplash/Pexels image URLs from the media section.
